sources.snippet: Overview multi-qa-MiniLM-L6-cos-v1 is a sentence embedding model maintained by sentence-transformers that maps sentences and paragraphs to 384-dimensional dense vectors optimized for semantic search. Built on the nreimers/MiniLM-L6-H384-uncased pre-trained backbone, the model was fine-tuned on 215 million question-answer pairs from diverse sources including WikiAnswers, PAQ, Stack Exchange, MS ...
